narration: Your job has nearly four thousand dollars sitting there with your name on it. Most workers never claim a single dollar. Here's what you're missing.
visual: Dark background. Person silhouette seated at desk. Three glowing money bags floating around them, each labeled with a benefit name. '$3,840' springs onto screen in large text.

narration: Forty-two percent of workers don't fully understand their benefits package — and that ignorance is quietly handing back thousands in real cash every year.
visual: Light background. Benefits enrollment checklist with five items, most unchecked. A checkmark animates into the first box to reveal the opportunity. '42% DON'T KNOW' bold headline.

narration: Number one: the Dependent Care FSA. If you pay for childcare, this account cuts your tax bill by up to two thousand dollars a year — and most parents completely skip it.
visual: Dark background. School/daycare building SVG with small child figures. '$2,000 SAVED' counter animates up. 'DEPENDENT CARE FSA' label with green accent glow.

narration: Number two: tuition reimbursement. Your employer will pay up to fifty-two hundred a year for your education — but only two percent of workers eligible for this ever claim it.
visual: Light background. Graduation cap SVG with diploma scroll. '$5,250/YEAR' springs in. '2% CLAIM IT' counter bar showing tiny slice of eligible workers.

narration: Number three: your employer's HSA contribution. The average company adds eight hundred and seventy-eight dollars to your health savings account — and most workers let it sit uninvested.
visual: Dark background. HSA card shape and shield icon. '$878 FREE MONEY' label. Horizontal bar filling up to show employer contribution vs unused potential.

narration: Log into your benefits portal today. You've already earned this money — you're just not collecting it. Follow for a new money trap every single day.
visual: Light background. Laptop SVG showing a benefits portal screen. Arrow pointing at 'LOG IN'. Green checkmark animation. 'CLAIM WHAT'S YOURS' headline bold.
